/legal/terms.title: General Terms of Use — Sakora
/legal/terms.description: Sakora is a business app for inventory, sales, invoices, a shareable online shop, WhatsApp selling, and payments. By creating an account, you agree to these General Terms of Use.

/legal/merchant-terms.description: If you sell through Sakora, you are the merchant. You set prices, stock, delivery, refunds, and customer support. Customers contract with you, not with Sakora, for the goods or services they buy.

/legal/privacy.description: We collect the name, email, phone, and business details you submit, plus products, sales, orders, invoices, and device/session data needed to run the app.
